text: Opened ticket: SD-WAN tunnel to our Denver branch drops every 20-30 minutes since firmware 9.3.0.
Thanks for the report -- can you confirm the tunnel type (IPsec vs GRE) and share the last 24h of VPN logs?
IPsec. Logs attached via the support portal upload.
Identified a rekey timing bug introduced in 9.3.0. Hotfix 9.3.1 is being staged for your account.
Hotfix deployed and confirmed stable for 18 hours. Closing this ticket -- please reopen if the issue recurs.
Ticket closed by Alex Rivera
12 new Windows laptops are showing 'license not found' when activating Aegis Endpoint.
Seat count on your entitlement looked correct -- pushing a fresh activation token now.
All 12 devices now show Active in the console on our end. Marking resolved.
Invoice INV-2025-0096 shows as Overdue but we don't see a corresponding PO confirmation -- can you clarify?
That invoice covers the Argus XDR Forensics Add-on (ORD-2025-0096). I'll have billing resend the original PO confirmation.
Confirmation resent to your billing contact. Closing this out -- let us know if payment still doesn't reconcile.
Ticket closed by Casey Morgan
Argus XDR has been generating 200+ alerts/day for a benign internal scanning tool, burying real signal.
Can you share the process name/hash so we can scope a suppression rule?
Process is qualys-cloud-agent.exe, hash shared via secure upload.
Suppression rule deployed to your tenant. Alert volume should drop significantly -- marking resolved.
Would love a CSV export button on the Entitlements & Licenses page for our internal audit tracking.
Meridian Remote Access Client fails posture check on macOS 15 devices -- blocks all app access.
Known issue with macOS 15's new TCC permissions model. Workaround: grant Full Disk Access manually, patch in progress.
Client v2.8.3 fixes this natively -- please update from the Downloads page. Closing ticket.
Ticket closed by Jordan Ellis
Do you have a timeline for AWS GovCloud region support in CloudWarden CSPM?
GovCloud support is on our Q4 roadmap. Could you share your specific compliance driver (FedRAMP/DoD IL) so we can prioritize correctly?
Following up -- still need that compliance detail from your side to route this to the right product team.
Firmware rollout to our 6 SentryWall 3200 units via Central Manager has been stuck at 40% for 3 hours.
Central Manager job queue was backed up on our side -- restarted the orchestration service.
Rollout completed on all 6 units, confirmed on firmware 9.4.2. Marking resolved.
Can we get pricing for 50 additional Sentinel Mail Security seats?
Quote sent to your billing contact -- 50 seats at your current Premium tier rate.
Received, thank you -- we'll process this through the Configurator directly.
Ticket closed by Dana Whitfield
HA failover on our IronGate VPN500 pair did not trigger during a WAN outage last night -- both units stayed passive.
Escalated to hardware engineering. Requesting a diagnostic bundle from both units.
Diagnostics point to a heartbeat VLAN misconfiguration. Scheduling a live session to correct it.
Live session rescheduled at customer's request -- proposing next Tuesday 10am ET.
Vantage Threat Intelligence Feed STIX/TAXII endpoint has been returning 403 Forbidden since this morning.
API credential rotation on our side likely caused this. Issuing a fresh API key for your account now.
New key resolved it for a few weeks but we're seeing intermittent 403s again -- reopening investigation on your end?
Could the Argus Forensics workbench support exporting the process-tree timeline as a signed audit log for SOC 2 evidence?
Sentinel Mail Archiving search results seem to be missing messages from the last 2 weeks.
Indexing lag confirmed on our end, backfill job queued.
Backfill complete -- can you confirm on your side that recent messages now appear in search?
BastionSIEM connector's auth token is expiring every 24 hours instead of the documented 30 days, breaking our log forwarding nightly.
Aegis Mobile Agent is flagging several non-jailbroken iOS 19 devices as jailbroken, blocking corporate email access.
After migrating our SentryWall Virtual Edition instances to a new VPC, the license key won't reactivate -- getting 'hardware ID mismatch'.
